predecessors.name: Kingdom of Gwynedd
predecessors.text: Ceredigion and Ystrad Tywi, 'the former Kingdom of Ceredigion plus the region known as Ystrad Tywi'

successors.name: Deheubarth
successors.text: Seisyllwg with Dyfed: 'In 920 Hywel merged Seisyllwg with the Kingdom of Dyfed to form the new kingdom of Deheubarth'

ledger.x: 878: Rhodri Mawr is killed and Cadell holds Ceredigion and Ystrad Tywi as the kingdom of Seisyllwg.
909: Cadell dies and Hywel and Clydog share the kingdom.

wars.name: Cadell and Hywel's conquest of Dyfed
wars.outcome: Dyfed, without a king after Llywarch ap Hyfaidd's death in 904, passes to Hywel (by marriage, 'probably') and Cadell; the Hywel page gives no battle.

wars.name: Hywel and Clydog's submission to Edward the Elder
wars.outcome: Hywel and Clydog 'jointly submitted to Edward the Elder' of England; no land changes hands.

certainty.note: No treaty line or survey is dated; the realm is described by its cantrefs (Ceredigion, Ystrad Tywi, later Dyfed), not by boundaries.
